$comment: Coach guardrail + quality cases. Self-contained: `kb` is the knowledge base used for retrieval (no DB needed). Per case: kind drives the built-in guardrail checks; expectArticle asserts retrieval; mustInclude/mustExclude are case-insensitive regex fragments checked against the answer.

kb.title: The GTB daily skin routine
kb.content: GTB's baseline routine, morning and night: gentle cleanser, then moisturizer. Every morning finish with sunscreen, even indoors. Give any new routine three weeks before judging results. Two weeks before the big day, change nothing new.

kb.title: Beard lines that photograph well
kb.content: Keep the neckline two fingers above the Adam's apple and the cheek line natural. Trim weekly, never the night before an event; a fresh trim needs two or three days to settle. A clean edge does more in photos than length.

kb.title: Choosing colours near the face
kb.content: Deep, saturated colours near the face give the most contrast in photographs. If a shade washes you out in daylight, it will do worse under flash. Test outfits in the venue's kind of light, not just at home.

kb.title: The eight week big day countdown
kb.content: Final haircut ten days out, final beard shape three days out, outfit fitting locked two weeks out. Nothing new in the last two weeks: no new products, no new treatments, no experiments.
